DRAFT 1 — On the Estonian Company

"Why Estonia?"

Because Hungary takes 40%.
Because my editor gets paid before I do.
Because the math is broken.

Estonia:
- 0% corporate tax on reinvested profits
- Pay for services FIRST
- Invoice as a solopreneur
- Keep the rest in the company

I don't want to evade taxes.
I want to be smart about them.

240K subscribers taught me:
Revenue means nothing if you're bleeding it all out.

Fix the foundation.
Then build higher.
